answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, published publicly on failure, each submission carries a fresh nonce. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. By the summit of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The nebula is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the spiral.
